'''Aaron Hanten''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Phoenix Mega Tournament (4 November)]] on 4 November 2000 with Asteroid Sanctuary, according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1433">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-twod1433/ phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-two], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 7 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-07-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-twod1433/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
